scientific_integrity: Exact recurrence and explicit rational stabilization estimates; finite arithmetic is not substituted for the infinite-size proof.
scientific_limitations: Only vertex RSA on one chorded cycle, not other distances or stochastic dominance. Main proof uses exact finite rational checks through N=28 and analytic factorial-locality bound for all N>=29. Older Pippenger full text not accessible; bibliographic overlap risk remains.
title: A triangle-free shortcut enhances random sequential adsorption on almost every cycle
